Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Girish Kathpalia
 Order
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 682/2021 of Police Station Nangloi for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the respondent no.2 has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
3. Learned APP accepts notice and submits that prosecution has no objection to this petition.
4. Respondent no. 2, identified by IO/SI Bajrang, accepts notice.
5. For recording statement of parties, list before Joint Registrar concerned on 27.03.2026.
